title: Copy to Import/Remote Directory Across Network
source_tip:
Add the directory to be copied (POLIKS case number).
Hint: when a directory is selected, a check might take some time.
delete_source_tip: Delete the last source directory from the list
destination_tip:
Destination directory for the copy process
(subdirectory of <Import>).
select_todo: What should happen after the upload?
todo_tip:
Selection, what to do after the upload.
If a task is selected, a ready.txt and a metadata file will be created.
create_todo_tip:
Creates instructions for further processing in an already uploaded directory.
A trigger and a metadata file will be created.
For this, a dialog is opened first.
no_sub_dirs_todo: No subdirectories found that are suitable for further processing
select_todo_dir: Select the subdirectory in which the further processing option should be set
todo_created: The further processing #1 for #2 has been set
sendmail_tip:
When checked, an email is sent after
the upload to the import directory is completed.
address_tip:
This email address is used to send the status mail after upload.
This should be your address for most use cases.
log_tip:
When checked, a log file is generated.
For this, a dialog is opened after
the copy process is completed.
start_tip:
Starts the copy process of the selected folders
to the MSD import directory.
update_message: Download new version and exit this application?
